summary: Elevra Lithium Ltd filed a Form 6-K providing its Quarterly Activities Report for June 2026. The filing details operational performance including production records at North American Lithium, progress on growth projects (NAL Expansion, Moblan, Carolina Lithium), and a previously announced Strategic Financing Package comprising an institutional placement and convertible notes. The report is a routine quarterly operational update and does not trigger a new special-situations event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or activist campaign. No material structural change or strategic review is announced; the financing was already disclosed and is proceeding per plan.
